patch_description: Preserves the high-performing regime gate, unconditional reciprocal acceptance, balanced-layer growth, and protection of coordination ties from the current policy. It crosses in the inspiration policy’s strongest local heuristics: first prefer a missing partner that simultaneously closes a triangle and creates cross-layer overlap, then any observable triangle closure, then an overlap partner. Bounded random sampling remains the fallback, maintaining connectivity and exploration when no locally coordinated addition exists. This should densify valuable high-triangle networks faster without introducing the inspiration policy’s harmful sacrifice or deletion rules.
